item.title: Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs
item.summary: Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs A vanity domain name ( stolen-thoughts.com ) for a neat paper : Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google return encrypted chain-of-thought blocks to clients that can be replayed across sessions, users, and models. We take a trace produced by a frontier model, replay it into a weaker sibling, jailbreak the weaker model, and recover the stronger model’s hidden reasoning in plaintext You can see an example of these encrypted blocks by running: curl https://api.openai.com/v1/responses \ -H " Content-Type: application/json " \ -H " Authorization: Bearer $( llm keys get openai ) " \ -d ' { "model": "gpt-5.6-luna", "input": "Solve step by step: What is the smallest positive integer divisible by every integer from 1 through 20?", "reasoning": { "effort": "medium" }, "include": ["reasoning.encrypted_content"], "store": false, "stream": false } ' Here's the full output , which includes chunks that look like this: "output": [ { "id": "rs_0a7479de7ebae170016a7ba1a0334c8198a95590217efe343c", "type": "reasoning", "content": [], "encrypted_content": "gAAAAABqe6GjepE1wDjbFCZg0BHB6ucGnN0jvzqygG...
